entities.summary: Bruno De Wever is a Belgian historian who specializes in the history of Flemish nationalism and of World War II. Since the 1980s, he has weighed in on the debate surrounding the war in Flanders. His younger brother Bart has been incumbent prime minister of Belgium since 2025.
